title: Docs: Skill Now Clarifies socket-request Is Not Singleton

Fixed: The bundled skill.md now explicitly documents that socket-request blocks are NOT singleton — multiple WebSocket/gRPC requests per file, one per request-separator section, is intentional and matches the existing multi-request-per-file support. Previously unstated, which risked an AI agent incorrectly "deduplicating" a valid multi-socket file.

title: Headless Request-Build Merge Fix & Inline Block Help

Added: The socket-request block (WebSocket and gRPC) now shows an inline "?" help tooltip in its header, matching the other request blocks
Fixed: Headless (CLI / voiden-mcp) WebSocket and gRPC request building no longer discards headers contributed by another plugin's request-build handler (e.g. an auth-block header from voiden-advanced-auth, which also becomes the gRPC call's metadata) — the builder previously replaced the entire header set from scratch on every run, silently dropping anything set by a handler that ran earlier in the chain

Added: An "Open Documentation" item now appears in the right-click block menu for Request, Method, URL, Proto File, Messages, and gRPC Messages blocks, opening the Voiden Blocks docs in your system browser
Fixed: A gRPC Request block's documentation link now opens the gRPC docs page instead of the generic WebSocket one

Improved: AI skill documentation significantly expanded with accurate socket-request block attrs (smethod, proto, service, method, serverUrl, metadata), messages-node structure for both WebSocket and gRPC, and complete node hierarchy reference

title: Block Overview Panel Integration & Proto Path Fixes

Added: Block outline metadata for socket-request, messages-node, and grpc-messages-node so they display at their correct document positions with labels and previews in the Block Overview Panel
Fixed: Resolving a project-relative proto file path against the project root no longer doubles the path into a nonsensical, unresolvable location

Selecting a proto file that doesn't exist on the current machine (e.g. an absolute path from another system) now shows a clear error explaining the file is machine-specific, instead of a generic "not found" error
Remove catch-all shim from build pipeline for correct dependency bundling
Border colors in gRPC and WebSocket UI components are now theme-aware
gRPC connection failures now surface the actual error message in the response panel
Windows absolute proto file paths (C:\...) no longer get prepended with the project directory, resolving triple-path corruption on Windows

Added: Native file dialog for .proto file selection
Fixed: Protocol detection for imported gRPC files

title: Initial Release
description: WebSocket and gRPC support for Voiden.

Added: WebSocket connection with send/receive message view
